findings.summary: The player died by falling four times at the same jump in the opening ledge area before finally crossing. The small landing platform and gap are too demanding for the first task, which simply says to follow the path.

evidence.visual: The player runs along the opening green path and repeatedly jumps toward the small floating green platform under the entrance ahead. On four attempts the character falls below the platforms into the sky and respawns, only reaching the entrance on the fifth attempt.

findings.suggested_fix: Widen the small middle floating platform from one tile to two tiles wide and move it closer to the previous ledge, so the first jump in the game does not need a near-perfect landing.

findings.summary: After entering the plaza the objective says to reach a beacon, but no beacon is visible from the plaza floor. The player wandered and backtracked for about 40 seconds before finding the small green steps in a corner that lead onward.

telemetry: objective_update at 30.9 s text="Reach the beacon."
evidence.visual: For about 40 seconds the player loops around the brown pillars and crates, runs into side walls and back toward the entrance area, with no beacon visible on screen. Near the end of the window the player finds small green stepped platforms in a corner, climbs them, and follows the raised green ledge to the doorway.

findings.suggested_fix: Add a tall vertical beam of light above the green stepped platforms in the corner of the plaza, visible over the pillars from the entrance, so the stated beacon can actually be seen and matches the real way out.

findings.summary: The player died on the same enemy twice in the drop room before getting past on the third try. The creature sits directly in the only doorway ahead after the drop, so the player reaches it almost immediately with little time to react.

evidence.visual: The player drops into a green room where a red spotted mushroom creature is standing directly in the doorway ahead. The player runs into it and dies, repeats the drop and dies on it again, and only gets past on the third entry by jumping over it.

findings.suggested_fix: Move the red mushroom creature several metres to the side of the exit doorway, away from the straight line between the drop landing and the door, so the player can see it and choose to jump it before touching it.

findings.summary: The EXIT sign points the player into a branch that ends in a dead end. The player followed it, hit the end wall, and had to walk all the way back before taking the other branch.

evidence.visual: The player reaches a sign marked EXIT with a red arrow and follows it into the left-hand green corridor. That corridor ends at a solid green wall, the player turns around, retraces the whole corridor past the same sign, and then takes the other branch.

findings.suggested_fix: Rotate the red EXIT arrow 180 degrees so it points away from the fork_left dead end and toward the branch that leads to the corridor, and place the sign facing the player as they arrive at the junction.

findings.summary: The final corridor takes about 40 seconds of simply holding forward down one straight, empty path. Nothing changes, and there is nothing to do or decide until the finish flag appears at the end.

evidence.visual: The player runs in a straight line between tall green hedge walls for the whole window, passing the same grey pillars on both sides. There are no turns, obstacles, enemies or items to interact with until a small red flag appears near the very end.

findings.suggested_fix: Shorten this corridor by about half by moving the red flag and finish point to the halfway mark and deleting the repeated middle pillar sections, cutting roughly 20 seconds of empty running.
